product_col = None
customer_col = None
for row in range(1, data_ws.max_row + 1):
    headers = {}
    for col in range(1, data_ws.max_column + 1):
        val = data_ws.cell(row, col).value
        if isinstance(val, str):

    if "product" in headers and "customer" in headers:

        customer_col = headers["customer"]
